Powerful Earthquake Strikes Colombia, Causing Widespread Damage and Fatalities

A powerful earthquake of magnitude 7.4 struck Colombia, resulting in significant casualties and damage. Reports indicate between 132 and 254 deaths, with hundreds of people affected and an estimated 3,000 missing. Over 1,600 buildings were reported destroyed or damaged. Rescue operations are ongoing, with a notable incident of a 32-year-old woman being rescued alive from rubble 36 hours after the quake. The region experienced numerous aftershocks, causing fear among the population.
